2	## A5 night-skip glow (CHANGE-BRIEF.md §1.3–1.5). Loads the real slice, drives the state only through real

4	## from a node with a high process_priority, so it reads after every other _process() in the frame.

6	## Run at 30, 60 and 144:  ./scripts/run-test.sh test_night_skip.gd <fps>

8	
9	const SHADER_PATH := "res://shaders/night_skip.gdshader"
10	const MATERIAL_PATH := "res://materials/night_skip.tres"
11	const FADE_IN := 0.25
12	const FADE_OUT := 0.5
13	## Name -> [Variant type from get_shader_uniform_list(), type in the source, hint in the source, default in the source]
14	const UNIFORMS := {
15		"skip_amount": [TYPE_FLOAT, "float", "hint_range(0.0, 1.0)", "0.0"],
16		"skip_tint": [TYPE_COLOR, "vec4", "source_color", "vec4(1.0, 0.6, 0.2, 1.0)"],
17		"tint_strength": [TYPE_FLOAT, "float", "hint_range(0.0, 1.0)", "0.5"],
18	}

20	class Sampler extends Node:
21		var material: ShaderMaterial
22		var loop_state: Node
23		var samples: Array = []      ## per frame: {v, state, dt, paused, phase}
24	
25		func _ready() -> void:
26			process_priority = 1000
27			process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
28	
29		func _process(delta: float) -> void:
30			samples.append({
31				"v": float(material.get_shader_parameter(&"skip_amount")),
32				"state": loop_state.fast_forward and loop_state.phase == loop_state.Phase.NIGHT,
33				"dt": delta,
34				"paused": get_tree().paused,
35				"phase": loop_state.phase,
36			})
37	
38	var sampler: Sampler
39	var frame_s := 0.0      ## one frame period at time_scale 1 (1 / --fixed-fps)
40	
41	func run() -> bool:
42		check_source_and_uniforms()
43		var slice: Node = load("res://scenes/slice.tscn").instantiate()
44		root.add_child(slice)
45		await steps(3)
46		var bar := slice.get_node("HUD/StatusBar") as Control
47		check_material_wiring(slice, bar)
48		sampler = Sampler.new()
49		sampler.material = bar.material as ShaderMaterial
50		sampler.loop_state = ls
51		root.add_child(sampler)

54		print("frame period: %.5f s (%.1f fps)" % [frame_s, 1.0 / frame_s])
55		check("R1 0.0 before T", is_zero_approx(sampler.samples[-1].v), sampler.samples[-1].v)
56	
57		await rule_fade_in_out()
58		await rule_retrigger_continue()
59		await rule_release_mid_fade_in()
60		await rule_time_scale()
61		await rule_pause_freezes()
62		await rule_other_phase()
63		slice.queue_free()
64		await steps(2)
65		return true

67	# --- static contract: the shader text and its uniform list -------------------------------------------
68	
69	func check_source_and_uniforms() -> void:
70		var source := FileAccess.get_file_as_string(SHADER_PATH)
71		check("shader source readable", source != "", SHADER_PATH)
72		var re := RegEx.create_from_string("uniform\\s+(\\w+)\\s+(\\w+)\\s*:\\s*([^=;]+?)\\s*=\\s*([^;]+?)\\s*;")
73		var declared := {}
74		for m in re.search_all(source):
75			declared[m.get_string(2)] = [m.get_string(1), m.get_string(3), m.get_string(4)]
76		for uname in UNIFORMS:
77			var want: Array = UNIFORMS[uname]
78			check("source: %s %s : %s = %s" % [want[1], uname, want[2], want[3]],
79				declared.get(uname, []) == [want[1], want[2], want[3]], declared.get(uname, "missing"))
80		check("source: canvas_item, no sampler uniforms",
81			source.contains("shader_type canvas_item;") and not source.contains("sampler2D"), source.get_slice("\n", 0))
82	
83		var shader: Shader = load(SHADER_PATH)
84		var listed := {}
85		for u in shader.get_shader_uniform_list():
86			listed[u.name] = u.type
87		check("uniform list has exactly 3 uniforms (empty means the shader failed to parse)", listed.size() == 3, listed)
88		for uname in UNIFORMS:
89			check("uniform list: %s is %s" % [uname, type_string(UNIFORMS[uname][0])],
90				listed.get(uname, -1) == UNIFORMS[uname][0], type_string(listed.get(uname, TYPE_NIL)))
91	
92	func check_material_wiring(slice: Node, bar: Control) -> void:
93		var mat := bar.material as ShaderMaterial
94		check("R8 StatusBar has the night-skip ShaderMaterial", mat != null and mat.resource_path == MATERIAL_PATH, mat)
95		check("R8 that material uses the hand-written shader", mat != null and mat.shader != null and mat.shader.resource_path == SHADER_PATH, mat.shader if mat else null)
96		var others := []
97		for path in ["HUD/HUD", "HUD/NotesToast", "HUD/Dialogue", "HUD/Whiteout", "HUD/ScreenCards"]:
98			var n := slice.get_node_or_null(path) as CanvasItem
99			if n == null or n.material != null or n.use_parent_material:
100				others.append(path)
101		check("F3 no other HUD node carries a material (mute icons and talk hint stay untinted)", others.is_empty(), others)
102	
103	# --- driven rules ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
104	
105	## Game time from samples[from] until the value first equals target (inclusive), or -1 if it never does.
106	func time_to(from: int, target: float) -> float:
107		var t := 0.0
108		for i in range(from, sampler.samples.size()):
109			t += sampler.samples[i].dt
110			if is_equal_approx(sampler.samples[i].v, target):
111				return t
112		return -1.0
113	
114	## Index of the first sample at or after `from` whose state equals `state`.
115	func flip(from: int, state: bool) -> int:
116		for i in range(from, sampler.samples.size()):
117			if sampler.samples[i].state == state:
118				return i
119		return -1
120	
121	func wait_value(cond: Callable, max_frames := 600) -> void:
122		for i in max_frames:
123			if cond.call(sampler.samples[-1].v):
124				return
125			await steps(1)
126	
127	func within_frame(measured: float, expected: float, frame: float) -> bool:
128		return measured >= 0.0 and absf(measured - expected) <= frame + 1e-4
129	
130	func rule_fade_in_out() -> void:
131		var start := sampler.samples.size()
132		key(KEY_T, true)
133		await wait_value(func(v: float) -> bool: return is_equal_approx(v, 1.0))
134		await steps(10)
135		var on := flip(start, true)
136		var t_in := time_to(on, 1.0)
137		check("R1 R2 R3 fade-in 0.0 -> 1.0 in 0.25 s ± one frame", within_frame(t_in, FADE_IN, frame_s), "%.4f s game time" % t_in)
138		check("R1 holds 1.0 while T is held", is_equal_approx(sampler.samples[-1].v, 1.0), sampler.samples[-1].v)
139		var release := sampler.samples.size()
140		key(KEY_T, false)
141		await wait_value(func(v: float) -> bool: return is_zero_approx(v))
142		await steps(10)
143		var off := flip(release, false)
144		var t_out := time_to(off, 0.0)
145		check("R1 R2 R3 fade-out 1.0 -> 0.0 in 0.5 s ± one frame", within_frame(t_out, FADE_OUT, frame_s), "%.4f s game time" % t_out)
146	
147	func rule_retrigger_continue() -> void:
148		key(KEY_T, true)
149		await wait_value(func(v: float) -> bool: return is_equal_approx(v, 1.0))
150		var release := sampler.samples.size()
151		key(KEY_T, false)
152		await wait_value(func(v: float) -> bool: return v <= 0.6)
153		var repress := sampler.samples.size()
154		key(KEY_T, true)
155		await wait_value(func(v: float) -> bool: return is_equal_approx(v, 1.0))
156		await steps(5)
157		var on := flip(repress, true)
158		var before: float = sampler.samples[on - 1].v
159		var at: float = sampler.samples[on].v
160		var step_in: float = sampler.samples[on].dt / FADE_IN
161		check("R4 re-press mid-fade-out continues from the current value (no drop to 0)", at > before and before > 0.3, "%.4f -> %.4f" % [before, at])
162		check("R4 turns around at the fade-in rate", absf((at - before) - step_in) < 1e-4, "step %.5f, expected %.5f" % [at - before, step_in])
163		var biggest_drop := 0.0
164		for i in range(flip(release, false) + 1, sampler.samples.size()):
165			biggest_drop = maxf(biggest_drop, sampler.samples[i - 1].v - sampler.samples[i].v)
166		check("R4 no frame drops more than one fade-out step", biggest_drop <= frame_s / FADE_OUT + 1e-4, "largest drop %.5f" % biggest_drop)
167		var t_back := time_to(on, 1.0)
168		check("R4 back to 1.0 in (1 - v) × 0.25 s ± one frame", within_frame(t_back, (1.0 - before) * FADE_IN, frame_s), "%.4f s from v=%.3f" % [t_back, before])
169		key(KEY_T, false)
170		await wait_value(func(v: float) -> bool: return is_zero_approx(v))
171		await steps(5)
172	
173	func rule_release_mid_fade_in() -> void:
174		key(KEY_T, true)
175		await wait_value(func(v: float) -> bool: return v >= 0.6)
176		var release := sampler.samples.size()
177		key(KEY_T, false)
178		await wait_value(func(v: float) -> bool: return is_zero_approx(v))
179		await steps(5)
180		var off := flip(release, false)
181		var peak: float = sampler.samples[off - 1].v
182		var t_down := time_to(off, 0.0)
183		check("R5 T released mid-fade-in turns around from the current value", sampler.samples[off].v < peak and peak < 1.0, "peak %.3f" % peak)
184		check("R5 falls to 0 in v × 0.5 s ± one frame", within_frame(t_down, peak * FADE_OUT, frame_s), "%.4f s from v=%.3f (expected %.4f)" % [t_down, peak, peak * FADE_OUT])
185	
186	func rule_time_scale() -> void:
187		Engine.time_scale = 0.5
188		await steps(2)
189		var start := sampler.samples.size()
190		key(KEY_T, true)
191		await wait_value(func(v: float) -> bool: return is_equal_approx(v, 1.0))
192		await steps(3)
193		var on := flip(start, true)
194		var frames := 0
195		for i in range(on, sampler.samples.size()):
196			frames += 1
197			if is_equal_approx(sampler.samples[i].v, 1.0):
198				break
199		var game_t := time_to(on, 1.0)
200		var real_t := frames * frame_s
201		check("R6 time_scale 0.5: fade-in is still 0.25 s of scaled game time", within_frame(game_t, FADE_IN, frame_s * 0.5), "%.4f s" % game_t)
202		check("R6 time_scale 0.5: fade-in takes 0.5 s of real frames ± one frame", within_frame(real_t, FADE_IN / 0.5, frame_s), "%d frames = %.4f s" % [frames, real_t])
203		key(KEY_T, false)
204		await wait_value(func(v: float) -> bool: return is_zero_approx(v), 1200)
205		Engine.time_scale = 1.0
206		await steps(3)
207	
208	func rule_pause_freezes() -> void:
209		key(KEY_T, true)
210		await wait_value(func(v: float) -> bool: return v >= 0.4)
211		await tap(KEY_P)                     # real pause key; T is still held
212		await steps(2)
213		var frozen_from := sampler.samples.size()
214		await steps(30)
215		var values := {}
216		var all_paused := true
217		for i in range(frozen_from, sampler.samples.size()):
218			values[snappedf(sampler.samples[i].v, 1e-6)] = true
219			all_paused = all_paused and sampler.samples[i].paused
220		check("R7 tree is paused by the P key", all_paused, all_paused)
221		check("R7 value frozen while paused (30 frames, one value)", values.size() == 1, values.keys())
222		await tap(KEY_P)
223		await wait_value(func(v: float) -> bool: return is_equal_approx(v, 1.0))
224		check("R7 resumes after unpause and reaches 1.0", is_equal_approx(sampler.samples[-1].v, 1.0) and not paused, sampler.samples[-1].v)
225		key(KEY_T, false)
226		await wait_value(func(v: float) -> bool: return is_zero_approx(v))
227		await steps(3)
228	
229	## Hold T through the whole night: the dawn crash ends Phase.NIGHT, so the glow must fade out with T still held.
230	## Amma's call keeps the clock still, so close it first. Story._now() gates E presses on wall-clock time
231	## (the known A2 limitation), so wait real time between presses, as a player would.
232	func rule_other_phase() -> void:
233		for i in 30:
234			if not story.dialogue_active:
235				break
236			OS.delay_msec(400)
237			await tap(KEY_E)
238			await steps(2)
239		check("Amma's call closed through real E presses", not story.dialogue_active, story.conversation_id)
240		key(KEY_T, true)
241		var deadline := 40000
242		while ls.phase == ls.Phase.NIGHT and deadline > 0:
243			if story.dialogue_active:
244				OS.delay_msec(400)
245				await tap(KEY_E)
246			await steps(1)
247			deadline -= 1
248		check("reached the dawn crash with T held (real clock, ×8)", ls.phase == ls.Phase.CRASH, "phase %d, clock %.1f" % [ls.phase, ls.clock_minutes])
249		var start := sampler.samples.size() - 1
250		await steps(int(ceil((FADE_OUT + 0.1) / frame_s)))
251		var in_crash := true
252		for i in range(start, sampler.samples.size()):
253			in_crash = in_crash and sampler.samples[i].phase == ls.Phase.CRASH
254		check("R9 still in the crash phase with T held", in_crash and Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_T), in_crash)
255		check("R9 glow faded to 0 outside Phase.NIGHT within 0.5 s", is_zero_approx(sampler.samples[-1].v), "%.3f" % sampler.samples[-1].v)
256		key(KEY_T, false)
257		await steps(2)

extends "res://tests/harness.gd"
## A5 night-skip glow (CHANGE-BRIEF.md §1.3–1.5). Loads the real slice, drives the state only through real
## key presses (T to fast-forward, P to pause, E to close Amma's call), and samples skip_amount every frame
## from a node with a high process_priority, so it reads after every other _process() in the frame.
## Durations are game time: the sum of the frames' process deltas, as the driver sees them.
## Run at 30, 60 and 144:  ./scripts/run-test.sh test_night_skip.gd <fps>
## Headless draws nothing: this proves parsing, the uniform contract and the driven values, never the look.

const SHADER_PATH := "res://shaders/night_skip.gdshader"
const MATERIAL_PATH := "res://materials/night_skip.tres"
const FADE_IN := 0.25
const FADE_OUT := 0.5
## Name -> [Variant type from get_shader_uniform_list(), type in the source, hint in the source, default in the source]
const UNIFORMS := {
	"skip_amount": [TYPE_FLOAT, "float", "hint_range(0.0, 1.0)", "0.0"],
	"skip_tint": [TYPE_COLOR, "vec4", "source_color", "vec4(1.0, 0.6, 0.2, 1.0)"],
	"tint_strength": [TYPE_FLOAT, "float", "hint_range(0.0, 1.0)", "0.5"],
}

class Sampler extends Node:
	var material: ShaderMaterial
	var loop_state: Node
	var samples: Array = []      ## per frame: {v, state, dt, paused, phase}

	func _ready() -> void:
		process_priority = 1000
		process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS

	func _process(delta: float) -> void:
		samples.append({
			"v": float(material.get_shader_parameter(&"skip_amount")),
			"state": loop_state.fast_forward and loop_state.phase == loop_state.Phase.NIGHT,
			"dt": delta,
			"paused": get_tree().paused,
			"phase": loop_state.phase,
		})

var sampler: Sampler
var frame_s := 0.0      ## one frame period at time_scale 1 (1 / --fixed-fps)

func run() -> bool:
	check_source_and_uniforms()
	var slice: Node = load("res://scenes/slice.tscn").instantiate()
	root.add_child(slice)
	await steps(3)
	var bar := slice.get_node("HUD/StatusBar") as Control
	check_material_wiring(slice, bar)
	sampler = Sampler.new()
	sampler.material = bar.material as ShaderMaterial
	sampler.loop_state = ls
	root.add_child(sampler)
	await steps(5)
	frame_s = sampler.samples[-1].dt
	print("frame period: %.5f s (%.1f fps)" % [frame_s, 1.0 / frame_s])
	check("R1 0.0 before T", is_zero_approx(sampler.samples[-1].v), sampler.samples[-1].v)

	await rule_fade_in_out()
	await rule_retrigger_continue()
	await rule_release_mid_fade_in()
	await rule_time_scale()
	await rule_pause_freezes()
	await rule_other_phase()
	slice.queue_free()
	await steps(2)
	return true

# --- static contract: the shader text and its uniform list -------------------------------------------

func check_source_and_uniforms() -> void:
	var source := FileAccess.get_file_as_string(SHADER_PATH)
	check("shader source readable", source != "", SHADER_PATH)
	var re := RegEx.create_from_string("uniform\\s+(\\w+)\\s+(\\w+)\\s*:\\s*([^=;]+?)\\s*=\\s*([^;]+?)\\s*;")
	var declared := {}
	for m in re.search_all(source):
		declared[m.get_string(2)] = [m.get_string(1), m.get_string(3), m.get_string(4)]
	for uname in UNIFORMS:
		var want: Array = UNIFORMS[uname]
		check("source: %s %s : %s = %s" % [want[1], uname, want[2], want[3]],
			declared.get(uname, []) == [want[1], want[2], want[3]], declared.get(uname, "missing"))
	check("source: canvas_item, no sampler uniforms",
		source.contains("shader_type canvas_item;") and not source.contains("sampler2D"), source.get_slice("\n", 0))

	var shader: Shader = load(SHADER_PATH)
	var listed := {}
	for u in shader.get_shader_uniform_list():
		listed[u.name] = u.type
	check("uniform list has exactly 3 uniforms (empty means the shader failed to parse)", listed.size() == 3, listed)
	for uname in UNIFORMS:
		check("uniform list: %s is %s" % [uname, type_string(UNIFORMS[uname][0])],
			listed.get(uname, -1) == UNIFORMS[uname][0], type_string(listed.get(uname, TYPE_NIL)))

func check_material_wiring(slice: Node, bar: Control) -> void:
	var mat := bar.material as ShaderMaterial
	check("R8 StatusBar has the night-skip ShaderMaterial", mat != null and mat.resource_path == MATERIAL_PATH, mat)
	check("R8 that material uses the hand-written shader", mat != null and mat.shader != null and mat.shader.resource_path == SHADER_PATH, mat.shader if mat else null)
	var others := []
	for path in ["HUD/HUD", "HUD/NotesToast", "HUD/Dialogue", "HUD/Whiteout", "HUD/ScreenCards"]:
		var n := slice.get_node_or_null(path) as CanvasItem
		if n == null or n.material != null or n.use_parent_material:
			others.append(path)
	check("F3 no other HUD node carries a material (mute icons and talk hint stay untinted)", others.is_empty(), others)

# --- driven rules ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Game time from samples[from] until the value first equals target (inclusive), or -1 if it never does.
func time_to(from: int, target: float) -> float:
	var t := 0.0
	for i in range(from, sampler.samples.size()):
		t += sampler.samples[i].dt
		if is_equal_approx(sampler.samples[i].v, target):
			return t
	return -1.0

## Index of the first sample at or after `from` whose state equals `state`.
func flip(from: int, state: bool) -> int:
	for i in range(from, sampler.samples.size()):
		if sampler.samples[i].state == state:
			return i
	return -1

func wait_value(cond: Callable, max_frames := 600) -> void:
	for i in max_frames:
		if cond.call(sampler.samples[-1].v):
			return
		await steps(1)

func within_frame(measured: float, expected: float, frame: float) -> bool:
	return measured >= 0.0 and absf(measured - expected) <= frame + 1e-4

func rule_fade_in_out() -> void:
	var start := sampler.samples.size()
	key(KEY_T, true)
	await wait_value(func(v: float) -> bool: return is_equal_approx(v, 1.0))
	await steps(10)
	var on := flip(start, true)
	var t_in := time_to(on, 1.0)
	check("R1 R2 R3 fade-in 0.0 -> 1.0 in 0.25 s ± one frame", within_frame(t_in, FADE_IN, frame_s), "%.4f s game time" % t_in)
	check("R1 holds 1.0 while T is held", is_equal_approx(sampler.samples[-1].v, 1.0), sampler.samples[-1].v)
	var release := sampler.samples.size()
	key(KEY_T, false)
	await wait_value(func(v: float) -> bool: return is_zero_approx(v))
	await steps(10)
	var off := flip(release, false)
	var t_out := time_to(off, 0.0)
	check("R1 R2 R3 fade-out 1.0 -> 0.0 in 0.5 s ± one frame", within_frame(t_out, FADE_OUT, frame_s), "%.4f s game time" % t_out)

func rule_retrigger_continue() -> void:
	key(KEY_T, true)
	await wait_value(func(v: float) -> bool: return is_equal_approx(v, 1.0))
	var release := sampler.samples.size()
	key(KEY_T, false)
	await wait_value(func(v: float) -> bool: return v <= 0.6)
	var repress := sampler.samples.size()
	key(KEY_T, true)
	await wait_value(func(v: float) -> bool: return is_equal_approx(v, 1.0))
	await steps(5)
	var on := flip(repress, true)
	var before: float = sampler.samples[on - 1].v
	var at: float = sampler.samples[on].v
	var step_in: float = sampler.samples[on].dt / FADE_IN
	check("R4 re-press mid-fade-out continues from the current value (no drop to 0)", at > before and before > 0.3, "%.4f -> %.4f" % [before, at])
	check("R4 turns around at the fade-in rate", absf((at - before) - step_in) < 1e-4, "step %.5f, expected %.5f" % [at - before, step_in])
	var biggest_drop := 0.0
	for i in range(flip(release, false) + 1, sampler.samples.size()):
		biggest_drop = maxf(biggest_drop, sampler.samples[i - 1].v - sampler.samples[i].v)
	check("R4 no frame drops more than one fade-out step", biggest_drop <= frame_s / FADE_OUT + 1e-4, "largest drop %.5f" % biggest_drop)
	var t_back := time_to(on, 1.0)
	check("R4 back to 1.0 in (1 - v) × 0.25 s ± one frame", within_frame(t_back, (1.0 - before) * FADE_IN, frame_s), "%.4f s from v=%.3f" % [t_back, before])
	key(KEY_T, false)
	await wait_value(func(v: float) -> bool: return is_zero_approx(v))
	await steps(5)

func rule_release_mid_fade_in() -> void:
	key(KEY_T, true)
	await wait_value(func(v: float) -> bool: return v >= 0.6)
	var release := sampler.samples.size()
	key(KEY_T, false)
	await wait_value(func(v: float) -> bool: return is_zero_approx(v))
	await steps(5)
	var off := flip(release, false)
	var peak: float = sampler.samples[off - 1].v
	var t_down := time_to(off, 0.0)
	check("R5 T released mid-fade-in turns around from the current value", sampler.samples[off].v < peak and peak < 1.0, "peak %.3f" % peak)
	check("R5 falls to 0 in v × 0.5 s ± one frame", within_frame(t_down, peak * FADE_OUT, frame_s), "%.4f s from v=%.3f (expected %.4f)" % [t_down, peak, peak * FADE_OUT])

func rule_time_scale() -> void:
	Engine.time_scale = 0.5
	await steps(2)
	var start := sampler.samples.size()
	key(KEY_T, true)
	await wait_value(func(v: float) -> bool: return is_equal_approx(v, 1.0))
	await steps(3)
	var on := flip(start, true)
	var frames := 0
	for i in range(on, sampler.samples.size()):
		frames += 1
		if is_equal_approx(sampler.samples[i].v, 1.0):
			break
	var game_t := time_to(on, 1.0)
	var real_t := frames * frame_s
	check("R6 time_scale 0.5: fade-in is still 0.25 s of scaled game time", within_frame(game_t, FADE_IN, frame_s * 0.5), "%.4f s" % game_t)
	check("R6 time_scale 0.5: fade-in takes 0.5 s of real frames ± one frame", within_frame(real_t, FADE_IN / 0.5, frame_s), "%d frames = %.4f s" % [frames, real_t])
	key(KEY_T, false)
	await wait_value(func(v: float) -> bool: return is_zero_approx(v), 1200)
	Engine.time_scale = 1.0
	await steps(3)

func rule_pause_freezes() -> void:
	key(KEY_T, true)
	await wait_value(func(v: float) -> bool: return v >= 0.4)
	await tap(KEY_P)                     # real pause key; T is still held
	await steps(2)
	var frozen_from := sampler.samples.size()
	await steps(30)
	var values := {}
	var all_paused := true
	for i in range(frozen_from, sampler.samples.size()):
		values[snappedf(sampler.samples[i].v, 1e-6)] = true
		all_paused = all_paused and sampler.samples[i].paused
	check("R7 tree is paused by the P key", all_paused, all_paused)
	check("R7 value frozen while paused (30 frames, one value)", values.size() == 1, values.keys())
	await tap(KEY_P)
	await wait_value(func(v: float) -> bool: return is_equal_approx(v, 1.0))
	check("R7 resumes after unpause and reaches 1.0", is_equal_approx(sampler.samples[-1].v, 1.0) and not paused, sampler.samples[-1].v)
	key(KEY_T, false)
	await wait_value(func(v: float) -> bool: return is_zero_approx(v))
	await steps(3)

## Hold T through the whole night: the dawn crash ends Phase.NIGHT, so the glow must fade out with T still held.
## Amma's call keeps the clock still, so close it first. Story._now() gates E presses on wall-clock time
## (the known A2 limitation), so wait real time between presses, as a player would.
func rule_other_phase() -> void:
	for i in 30:
		if not story.dialogue_active:
			break
		OS.delay_msec(400)
		await tap(KEY_E)
		await steps(2)
	check("Amma's call closed through real E presses", not story.dialogue_active, story.conversation_id)
	key(KEY_T, true)
	var deadline := 40000
	while ls.phase == ls.Phase.NIGHT and deadline > 0:
		if story.dialogue_active:
			OS.delay_msec(400)
			await tap(KEY_E)
		await steps(1)
		deadline -= 1
	check("reached the dawn crash with T held (real clock, ×8)", ls.phase == ls.Phase.CRASH, "phase %d, clock %.1f" % [ls.phase, ls.clock_minutes])
	var start := sampler.samples.size() - 1
	await steps(int(ceil((FADE_OUT + 0.1) / frame_s)))
	var in_crash := true
	for i in range(start, sampler.samples.size()):
		in_crash = in_crash and sampler.samples[i].phase == ls.Phase.CRASH
	check("R9 still in the crash phase with T held", in_crash and Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_T), in_crash)
	check("R9 glow faded to 0 outside Phase.NIGHT within 0.5 s", is_zero_approx(sampler.samples[-1].v), "%.3f" % sampler.samples[-1].v)
	key(KEY_T, false)
	await steps(2)

const SCENE := "res://scenes/slice.tscn"

	check("FootstepScuffs container present in slice.tscn", trigger != null, trigger)

	check("no scuff at scene load (frame 1, before any input)",
		trigger.get_child_count() == 0, trigger.get_child_count())

	check("Amma's call is active on load", story.dialogue_active, story.conversation_id)
	check("movement is locked on load", story.movement_locked(), story.movement_locked())
	var before_locked := trigger.get_child_count()
	key(KEY_D, true)
	await steps(30)
	key(KEY_D, false)

		"%d children, dialogue=%s" % [trigger.get_child_count(), story.dialogue_active])

			break

		await steps(2)

		not story.dialogue_active, story.conversation_id)

	var idle_before := trigger.get_child_count()
	await steps(60)
	check("no scuff while standing still (60 frames idle after dialogue)",
		trigger.get_child_count() == idle_before,
		"%d (was %d)" % [trigger.get_child_count(), idle_before])

	var walk_start := trigger.get_child_count()
	var walk_start_x := hari.global_position.x

		var n := trigger.get_child_count()
		while seen < n:
			var inst := trigger.get_child(seen) as Node3D
			fires.append({"inst": inst, "x": inst.global_position.x,
				"y": inst.global_position.y, "z": inst.global_position.z,
				"hari_x": hari.global_position.x, "hari_z": hari.global_position.z})
			seen += 1
		if fires.size() >= 3:
			break
	key(KEY_D, false)
	await steps(2)
	check("walking fired >= 3 scuffs (rule 8: once per footfall)",
		fires.size() >= 3,
		"%d fires in %.2f m of walk" % [fires.size(), hari.global_position.x - walk_start_x])

			absf(f0["x"] - f0["hari_x"]) <= XZ_TOL and absf(f0["z"] - f0["hari_z"]) <= XZ_TOL,
			"fire(%.3f,%.3f) vs hari(%.3f,%.3f)"
				% [f0["x"], f0["z"], f0["hari_x"], f0["hari_z"]])

	if fires.size() >= 2:
		var inst0: Node3D = fires[0]["inst"]
		var inst1: Node3D = fires[1]["inst"]
		check("fires 0 and 1 are distinct instances (new per footfall, not reset)",
			inst0 != inst1, "%s vs %s" % [inst0, inst1])
		check("fire 0 still alive when fire 1 arrives (overlap, not replaced)",
			is_instance_valid(inst0) and is_instance_valid(inst1),
			"inst0=%s inst1=%s" % [is_instance_valid(inst0), is_instance_valid(inst1)])

	# Rule 8: paused tree -> no new scuffs even with D held.
	var paused_before := trigger.get_child_count()
	await tap(KEY_P)
	await steps(2)
	check("P paused the tree", get_tree().paused, get_tree().paused)
	key(KEY_D, true)
	await steps(30)
	key(KEY_D, false)
	check("no new scuffs while paused (30 frames with D held)",
		trigger.get_child_count() == paused_before and get_tree().paused,
		"%d (was %d)" % [trigger.get_child_count(), paused_before])
	await tap(KEY_P)
	await steps(2)
	check("P unpaused the tree", not get_tree().paused, get_tree().paused)

	# Rule 10: Hari freed -> existing scuffs finish; no new ones created.
	var pre_free_count := trigger.get_child_count()
	key(KEY_D, true)
	for i in 60:
		await steps(1)
		if trigger.get_child_count() > pre_free_count:
			break
	key(KEY_D, false)
	await steps(2)
	check("at least one fresh scuff after unpausing and walking",
		trigger.get_child_count() > pre_free_count,
		"%d (was %d)" % [trigger.get_child_count(), pre_free_count])
	var survivor: Node3D = trigger.get_child(trigger.get_child_count() - 1)
	hari.queue_free()
	await steps(2)
	check("existing scuff still valid after Hari.queue_free() (rule 10)",
		is_instance_valid(survivor), survivor)
	var after_free := trigger.get_child_count()
	await steps(30)
	check("no new scuffs after Hari is freed (rule 10)",
		trigger.get_child_count() <= after_free,
		"%d (was %d)" % [trigger.get_child_count(), after_free])

	slice.queue_free()
	await steps(2)
	return true
